name: How To Make Cornmeal Using Popcorn

instructions.primary_message: In a high-powered blender, and starting at low speed and gradually increasing speed to high, blend popcorn kernels until meal is consistently ground to either a "fine" degree, depending on your needs (assessing "fine" is something you'll need to do visually, based on existing commercial products as a benchmark).

description: Grinding my own cornmeal was something I hadn't even begun to consider when I first stumbled upon discussions of how great the freshly milled variety made your cornbread, but it's as simple as using a high speed blender. You can even use the popcorn already in your pantry.
notes:
Notes: This recipe can easily be scaled up or down depending on the amount of cornmeal you need and the capacity of your blender bowl.

Make-ahead and storage: Cornmeal can be stored in an airtight plastic container on the shelf for several months.
author: Molly Sheridan
